reasons: Hand-typed file lists must be kept in step with the files.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Registry purpose
sections.what: Explains that media paths live in this file and that empty slots show labelled placeholders.
sections.why: Keeps media changes in one file.
sections.watch_out: A missing file shows a placeholder rather than an error, so a typo can go unnoticed.

sections.name: ImageAsset
sections.title: Image description shape
sections.what: Describes an image: file path, accessible description, size, and an optional focus point for cropping.
sections.why: Keeps every image described the same way.

sections.name: VideoAsset
sections.title: Video description shape
sections.what: Describes a video either as a local file or as an embed link from a video service, with an optional still image.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the two options in its comments.

sections.name: ImageSlot
sections.title: Image slot shape
sections.what: Describes a place in a layout that expects an image, with a label, a width-to-height ratio and an optional image.
sections.why: Lets an empty slot still hold its space and show its label.

sections.name: VideoSlot
sections.title: Video slot shape
sections.what: Describes a place in a layout that expects a video, with a label, a ratio and an optional video.
sections.why: Same purpose as image slots, for video.

sections.name: ProjectMedia
sections.title: Project media set shape
sections.what: Groups the cover, interface screenshots, demo video and codebase graph for one project.
sections.why: One shape for every project, so pages can rely on the same slots.

sections.name: portrait
sections.title: Portrait image
sections.what: Holds the site owner's portrait with its description, size and focus point.
sections.why: Keeps the image path and description in one place.
sections.watch_out: The description is read by screen readers, so update it if the photo changes.

sections.name: captures
sections.title: Screenshot list per build
sections.what: Lists the interface screenshot files for each build, in display order, with numbers that keep them sorted.
sections.why: Likely reason: the screenshots are chosen by hand and this list is their source for the gallery.
sections.watch_out: The comments say only synthetic or demo data may appear in captures, so keep real personal data out of them.

sections.name: labelFor
sections.title: Captions from file names
sections.what: Turns a screenshot file name such as 02-dashboard into a readable caption such as Dashboard.
sections.why: Captions come from file names, so they do not have to be typed twice.
sections.watch_out: The first letter of the first word is read directly, so an empty first part of a name would fail.

sections.name: SlotOverride
sections.title: Override shape
sections.what: Defines an optional version of a slot in which any field can be replaced for one project, except the kind label.
sections.why: Lets an override change only the fields it needs.
sections.watch_out: The examples in the comments have no effect until an entry is added to the override table.

sections.name: ProjectMediaOverride, projectMediaOverrides
sections.title: Empty override table
sections.what: Defines the shape of per-project overrides and an empty table to hold them.
sections.why: Likely reason: a place to hand-pick covers, demo videos and graphs without changing components.
sections.watch_out: The table is empty, so nothing is overridden yet.

sections.name: hasCaptures
sections.title: Check for screenshots
sections.what: Returns true when a build has at least one listed screenshot.
sections.why: Lets pages decide whether to show a gallery.

sections.name: mediaFor
sections.title: Builds the media set for a project
sections.what: For a build, returns its cover, screenshot slots, demo video slot and codebase graph slot, with any overrides applied; the cover defaults to the first screenshot.
sections.why: One function means every page builds media the same way.
sections.watch_out: Screenshot descriptions use the name passed in; if none is passed, the slug appears instead.

sections.name: paperSnapshot
sections.title: Paper snapshot path
sections.what: Gives the path to a snapshot image of a published paper, by paper id.
sections.why: Stated in the code: IEEE Xplore cannot be reached from the build sandbox, so a workflow captures the snapshots and missing ones fall back to a card.
sections.watch_out: A missing snapshot shows a card, so check that the workflow ran if a paper shows a card.

sections.name: Memory
sections.title: Memory photo shape
sections.what: Describes a memory photo: its role, description, year, size, optional link, optional video and optional spec sheet.
sections.why: Gives each photo the details the 3D Atlas needs.
sections.watch_out: The role id must match an id in the battle data, or the photo will not appear.

sections.name: memories
sections.title: Memory photo list
sections.what: The full list of memory photos and paper images, each tied to a role, with year, size and optional link.
sections.why: Likely reason: one list feeds the photo placement in the Atlas and the brain map.
sections.watch_out: Width and height must match the real image, or the 3D photo will be stretched.

sections.name: BuildVideoKind
sections.title: Three build video types
sections.what: Names the three video screens for every build: walkthrough, launch and demo.
sections.why: Keeps the set of video types fixed in one place.
sections.watch_out: A new type must also be added to the label list below.

sections.name: videoSlots
sections.title: Video slot labels
sections.what: Gives each video type its label and hint text.
sections.why: Keeps the wording with the type.

sections.name: buildVideos
sections.title: Build video files (empty)
sections.what: Maps each build to its available videos; empty now, with a commented example.
sections.why: Empty slots show as placeholders until a file is added.
sections.watch_out: Only the listed video types are used; a misspelt key is ignored without an error.

summary: The central registry of images and videos for projects, memories, papers and the portrait, plus helpers that decide what each slot shows.
purpose: Tells the site which file belongs to which build, memory or paper, and shows empty slots as labelled placeholders.
why: The header comment says placeholders are replaced here, never inside components, so media changes live in one file.
how: 1) Defines the shapes for images, videos and slots. 2) Lists the portrait and the screenshot files for each build. 3) Builds the media slots for a project (cover, screenshots, demo video, codebase graph), applying any overrides. 4) Keeps the memory photo list with the role each belongs to. 5) Maps each build to its walkthrough, launch and demo video slots.
inputs: File names under public/media, and override entries (currently none).
outputs: Media slots for projects, the memory list, paper snapshot paths and video slots.
risks: Screenshot dimensions are fixed guesses (1600 by 1000), so a different real size will distort layouts. Screenshot lists are typed by hand, so a new file must be added here. The override table is empty.
debug: If an image is blank, check the path and that the file exists under public. If a placeholder shows, the file name here is probably misspelled or missing. If memories are missing, check their role id against the battle data.
